name: What kind of existing spaces can be converted into a Junior ADU?

mainEntity.name: What kind of existing spaces can be converted into a Junior ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Junior ADUs are typically created from existing permitted spaces within a single-family residence. Common areas for conversion include attached garages, basements, or portions of the main dwelling that can be reconfigured. The suitability of a space depends on factors like its structural integrity, access to utilities, and potential for a separate entrance. AKN Design Group assesses these elements during the initial design phase to determine the most effective and compliant conversion approach for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Junior ADUs can be created from existing spaces like attached garages, basements, or reconfigured portions of the main house.
